parrafo_1.es: Loc'd Down By Toya es un estudio de locs y trenzas en NW 23rd Ave, Gainesville, fundado por Toya, loctician principal. Journey y Kapri completan el equipo, ambas especializadas en locs y trenzas saludables.
parrafo_1.en: Loc'd Down By Toya is a loc and braid studio on NW 23rd Ave in Gainesville, founded by Toya, master loctician. Journey and Kapri round out the team, both specializing in healthy locs and braids.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes vuelven por la misma razón: un 5.0 perfecto en 83 reseñas verificadas de Booksy, y un equipo que trata cada loc journey, cada trenza y cada estilo infantil con el mismo cuidado.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep coming back for the same reason: a perfect 5.0 rating across 83 verified Booksy reviews, and a team that treats every loc journey, every braid and every kids style with the same care.

texto.es: Eliges tu servicio en Booksy: mantenimiento de locs, trenzas, retwist o un estilo para niños.
texto.en: Pick your service on Booksy: loc maintenance, braids, retwist or a kids style.

texto.es: Toya o su equipo revisan tu cabello o tus locs y confirman el plan para tu cita.
texto.en: Toya or her team check your hair or locs and confirm the plan for your visit.

texto.es: Particiones cuidadosas, locs interlocked o trenzas hechas a mano, sección por sección.
texto.en: Careful parting and styling, locs interlocked or braids done by hand, section by section.

texto.es: Sales con un estilo terminado y consejos sencillos de cuidado para que dure fresco.
texto.en: You leave with a finished style and simple care tips to keep it looking fresh.

nota.es: Precios de partida publicados en Booksy para el menú completo de 23 servicios; el precio final puede variar con el largo y grosor del cabello.
nota.en: Starting prices published on Booksy for the full 23-service menu; final price can vary with hair length and thickness.

texto.es: Retwist y limpieza para locs ya establecidos, el servicio mas reservado del estudio.
texto.en: Retwist and cleanup for established locs, the most booked service at the studio.

texto.es: El primer paso de un loc journey nuevo, seccionado con cuidado y hecho a mano.
texto.en: The first step of a new loc journey, neatly sectioned and started by hand.

texto.es: Trenzas knotless sin tension en tamano mediano, favorita del estudio.
texto.en: Tension-free knotless braids in a medium size, a studio favorite.

texto.es: Interlocking de raiz a punta para un patron de locs limpio y uniforme.
texto.en: Root-to-tip interlocking for a clean, uniform loc pattern.

pie.es: 23 servicios en el menu, desde estilos para ninos hasta trenzas de hombre e instalacion de pelucas. Ve la lista completa con precios en Booksy.
pie.en: 23 services on the menu, from kids styles to men's braids and wig installs. See the full list with prices on Booksy.

items.quote: Toya has truly been taking care of my hair. I was quite nervous with starting my loc journey. she has been very knowledgeable and trustworthy. And I must say her pricing is very fair and reasonable as well!
I love my hair more and more each time I come to Toya. I absolutely love her as my loctician! Toya you rock!
Kapri was excellent, I'm excited about booking my next appointment
